info.name: GitLab api/v4/ Admin Project Webhooks API

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

items.docs: Returns a list of all webhooks configured for the specified project. Each webhook entry includes its URL, enabled event triggers, and SSL verification settings.

info.name: GitLab Add a Webhook to a Project

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

items.docs: Creates a new webhook for the specified project. The webhook will receive HTTP POST requests for the configured event triggers. A secret token can be specified for payload verification.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

items.docs: Returns configuration details for a specific webhook in a project, including the URL, enabled triggers, and SSL verification setting.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

items.docs: Modifies the configuration of an existing project webhook. You can update the URL, secret token, SSL verification setting, and which events trigger the webhook.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. For example, 42 or namespace%2Fproject-name.

items.docs: Removes a webhook from the specified project. Deleted webhooks will no longer receive event deliveries.
